description: Header file defining interface and constants for CCS811 sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register addresses, measurement modes, data structures, and function prototypes.

methods.name: ccs811_mutate_meas_mode
methods.description: Sets or clears measurement mode bits in the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_set_thresholds
methods.description: Configures threshold settings for the sensor.

methods.name: ccs811_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures trigger and handler for sensor events.

methods.name: ccs811_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes interrupt handling for the sensor.
